brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: Seed-starting tray of at least four cells
requirements.evidence: 4 Hex bases at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,-1,0 forming contiguous cluster, 4 cells

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bins hex-bin-full-drain in each cell: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain – drained type allows excess water to escape

finish.summary: Built 4-cell seed-starting tray using four Hex bases with full-depth drained bins, each filled with soil and planted with seedlings to demonstrate use. Open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
